angle.hook: Metaphor: ReFantazio is out on Switch 2 and Atlus owns up to a colour bug on day one
angle.why_now: launched today 12 Nov; Atlus page and bug notice dated 12 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: price 3,990 yen in Japan, same cut on other platforms' digital versions; three performance modes; patch in preparation
angle.payoff: the bug does not affect progress and a fix patch is being prepared
